blogs.title: Orthogonal Finetuning for Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Discover the core idea behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT): learning a small orthogonal transform that rotates neurons layer‑wise instead of tweaking weights outright. See how this elegant trick keeps the model’s original knowledge intact while giving it new creative powers.

blogs.title: Hyperspherical Energy — The Geometry That Protects Meaning
blogs.description: Learn what hyperspherical energy is and why it’s a powerful yardstick for semantic preservation in neural nets. We explain how maintaining neuron angles guarantees that your fine‑tuned model still recognises what it learned before.

blogs.title: Turn Your Own Photos Into New Worlds in Minutes
blogs.description: Explore how OFT upgrades DreamBooth‑style subject‑driven generation, letting you generate new scenes featuring a specific subject with just a handful of images while keeping identity and style sharp.

blogs.title: Supercharged Control in Diffusion Models
blogs.description: "Give me an edge map" or "here’s my face landmarks"—OFT makes it possible to impose precise control signals on robust diffusion models without heavy extra dicey nets like ControlNet.

blogs.title: "Fast + Stable + No Extra Overhead" – Why OFT Beats LoRA and Beyond
blogs.description: See the head‑to‑head comparison: fewer trainable parameters, quicker convergence, clearer training dynamics, and unchanged inference speed—all thanks to orthogonally rotating neurons rather than adding low‑rank adapters.
